title: Tap Tap Revenge: Nirvana
notes: Physical ARM64 test on 2026-11-03 with exact IPA SHA-256 bd3d74b23c94bc5da1afe8b99bc6e6902dafd0ec061295d24ecbaaf52e86ac88. Career lists bundled Breed and Lithium. Breed reached live notes and Game Stats in three bounded runs; two complete-song result files recorded is_complete=true. A no-input control scored 0/520 hits. In a separate run, 144 injected touches across three fret centers scored 58/520 hits (11.15% accuracy), proving note input reaches gameplay, not calibrated human timing. The result-screen High Scores tab displayed the completed run and Home returned to the menu; a fresh process launch reached the menu again. The test-created score-submission file survived that restart with the same SHA-256, but visual reloading of the old score after restart was not checked. Song loading can exceed 100 seconds. Audible music/quality, in-song pause/resume, Lithium, other modes and long-run stability remain unverified. Rating 3/5 is for this bounded Breed path only, not complete playability.

testedOn.device: POCO X3 NFC M2007J20CG (surya), Android 12, ARM64
